title: Pokemon TCG Card Zacian 136/182 S&V Paradox Rift Rare Black Star Holo NM
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Pokémon TCG card features the ancient and powerful Zacian, with 120 HP and 130 attack. The card is from the Scarlet & Violet - Paradox Rift set, with a card number of 136/182. It is a basic stage card with a holo finish, and is part of the chase features of the set. 

The card is made of high-quality card stock and was manufactured by Nintendo in the United States. It is in English language and is suitable for players aged 6+. The card depicts Zacian in various forms including Ancient Animal, Abnormal, Dog, and Flame. The card is perfect for collectors and players alike, and is a valuable addition to any collection.
